# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Titles:** Royal Gardner  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is described as adorably handsome, with glorious dark eyes and a deep, black, velvety smile. He possesses a delightfully pleading voice.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

## Personality

Roy is clever, polite, and displays unfailing and deferential courtesy. He is perceived as a romantic, melancholy, and inscrutable hero, though he lacks a sense of humor and fails to get the point of funny stories. While he appears interesting on the surface, his sister Dorothy considers him to actually not be very interesting in reality.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Roy Gardner was a student at Redmond College who had to pause his studies and travel abroad for two years to care for his sick mother. Upon returning, he actively courted Anne Shirley, sending her exotic flowers, sonnets, and exquisite letters. His romantic attentions made him widely envied and led many to expect an engagement. He introduced Anne to his mother and sisters, among whom Dorothy became a close friend of Anne. However, when he eventually expected to win her hand, Anne rejected his proposal, turning him down because she did not truly love him.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_
